message.reasoning:
We need to produce a JUnit 4 test file StructuralEvaluatorTest.java that comprehensively tests all methods in StructuralEvaluator, including inner classes: Root, Has, Not, Parent, ImmediateParent, PreviousSibling, ImmediatePreviousSibling, and toString methods.

We need to create mock Evaluator implementations to test behavior. Since Evaluator is abstract (likely from jsoup) with matches method; we can create simple stub evaluators that check tag name or attribute.

We need to create Element hierarchy. Use jsoup library's Element class. We'll create a Document with some elements using Jsoup.parse.

Test each evaluator:

- Root.matches: true only when root == element.

- Has.matches: returns true if any descendant (excluding element itself) matches evaluator. We'll need evaluator that matches on tag name, e.g., match elements with tag "span". Build tree where element has child span.

Test Not: simply negates.

Parent.matches: true if any ancestor (excluding root) matches evaluator. Need evaluator that matches tag "div". Test element inside nested structure.

ImmediateParent.matches: only direct parent matches.

PreviousSibling.matches: any preceding sibling matches evaluator.

ImmediatePreviousSibling.matches: only immediate previous sibling matches.

Also test toString formatting.

We need to import org.jsoup.Jsoup for building Document.

Make static inner test class.

JUnit 4 uses @Test annotation, assertTrue/assertFalse.

Edge cases: root == element returns false for all except Root.

Also test when evaluator matches root? For Parent, loop includes root check break condition.

Implementation details: create a helper method to build elements.

Let's craft.
